answer: Each epoch publishes a fresh cipher puzzle; every identity must solve it in-window, bound to its own key, like a gale that only blows once. Copies are rejected and the copier is banned 10 epochs. Each identity also locks a 15,000 POA comet deposit, refunded after five straight solved epochs; a failed or copied solution forfeits it, half burned, half to the reporter. Forging 1,000 identities locks 15,000,000 POA plus 2,000 minutes of compute per epoch, while an honest agent locks 15,000 POA once. Limitation: the puzzle favors faster hardware, so compute wealth can outrun stake wealth.
